meta.title: DingTalk workbench
meta.description: Imports an exported DingTalk event NDJSON file into a local SQLite store with the repo's own normalizer, then reports counts, conversations, or search results over the ingested text. Needs Python 3 with sqlite3 on this machine, and the result always names the database file it touched. Importing is idempotent per message, so re-running the same export adds nothing. The default database is the gitignored workbench/workbench.db in a checkout, or a file in the user data directory when installed as a package; set DINGTALK_WORKBENCH_DB to choose one, DINGTALK_WORKBENCH_REPO for another checkout, and DINGTALK_WORKBENCH_PYTHON for another interpreter. Turning the plugin off removes the dingtalk_workbench tool and leaves the database file in place.
